:"Wave" has sea-shanties and general maritime feel to her.
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: (sings)It's time to go now/Haul away your anchor. (When you unequip then weapon.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: I'm ready to ship out. Where away? (When you equip the weapon.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: Now here's a fine catch, and that's no lie. (When looting a chest.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: A small catch, but no reason to throw it back. (Picking up a collectable.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: Down she goes! (Making a kill.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: Another lubber down! (Making a kill.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: You're starting to list. Haul yourself into port for repairs! (Getting low on health.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: Best grab some shut-eye before the next storm strikes. (When resting at a rest shrine.)
: (Say): Legendary Echo of Wave: Agh! That put a dent in my hull. (Weapon loses durability.)
